name: knowledge
description: Import STEM textbooks as structured courses and study them interactively.

interface.shortDescription: Turn textbooks into courses and study them step by step.
interface.longDescription: Knowledge imports PDF and other textbook sources into progressively loaded course files with chapter order, prerequisites, equations, derivation flows, examples, and source pages, then teaches one concept at a time with hint-first checks for understanding.
defaultPrompt: Use $knowledge-import to turn this textbook PDF into a course.
Use $knowledge-study to teach me this course in chapter order.
